g.text: Twelve dimensions every design is checked against — the structure from arc42, the questions from the selling canon
FILLED = BLOCKS DELIVERY PLAIN = GRADED, NOT BLOCKING
AND THE METHODS UNDER THE REST OF IT
the account plan — scored on evidence per field
the question bank, graded by evidence strength
a decision record whose last line is what it cost
an evidence pack where 'not verified' is its own value
